findings.claim: The case `<= byte.MaxValue` was removed from a uint writer switch. Values 128..255 now fall to the `<= ushort.MaxValue` case and are written as UInt16 (0xCD + 2 bytes) instead of UInt8 (0xCC + 1 byte). That changes the serialized bytes for every such value, is unrelated to the crash fix, and makes output larger and non-canonical. Existing consumers, golden bytes and tests will notice it without opting in.

receipt_plan.detail: Serialize uint 200 (and 128, 255) with MessagePackSerializer on base-built and head-built code. Base yields CC C8; head yields CD 00 C8. Also run the existing primitives writer tests for uint/ulong boundaries.

findings.claim: The reportDiagnostic wrapper now drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation. This includes Location.None diagnostics, which diagnostics built from a null location become, such as MemberNeedsKey on a metadata property. It also covers diagnostics on derived types where the offending member is inherited from a referenced assembly. Users who previously got MsgPack004 or other errors with no source location will silently stop getting them. Some of these are Errors, so this is a behavior change in users' builds beyond the crash fix. Ledger L17 leaves the intended behavior for the inherited-member case undecided.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a [MessagePackObject] class in the compilation inherits a public property without [Key] from a base type in a referenced assembly. Run on base and head and compare MsgPack004 reporting. Head reports nothing.
